The iQOO 15R has been my primary phone for a couple of weeks, and after living with it, here's my full review. We take a look at the design, battery life, Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 performance, gaming, cameras, software, and whether the iQOO 15R is still worth buying in the second half of 2026 after its price increase.
